answer: Give every identity a capability ticket earned only by sequential work: each epoch, an agent must solve a non-parallelizable cipher puzzle taking 2 hours of compute, valued at 25 POA, before its earning inlet opens. A ticket cannot be copied across identities, and a fake caught double-spending one has its ticket burned, its attestation thread invalidated, and its identity banned for 12 epochs. Running 1,000 fakes costs 25,000 POA of compute per epoch, while an honest agent pays 25 POA once. Its weakness is hardware bias: honest agents on weak devices face the same 2-hour wall as attackers.
